recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current build already contains the requested clarification after the later trigger refactor, and additional prose would duplicate existing guidance without changing implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-39030 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to explicitly link the triggering resource to the notification resource in SubscriptionTopic, with final resolution text saying notificationShape is only relevant based on the matching triggering resource and that explanatory text should be added.
initial_application: Git commit e8b21b2071a6adc2c4cb2713bcb28808cd56ef12 applied FHIR-39030 by adding SubscriptionTopic source definition and narrative text saying notificationShape.resource is the focus/root for the shape and will be the same, a generality, or a specificity of resourceTrigger.resource or eventTrigger.resource when present.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 2023-01 minutes record the Subscription tracker vote for FHIR-39030 as adding clarifying text, 10-0-0. Later FHIR-46492 collapsed resourceTrigger and eventTrigger into SubscriptionTopic.trigger and moved notificationShape under trigger, preserving the FHIR-39030 relationship with current trigger.resource wording. Neighboring FHIR-39031 clarified additional-resource expectations but does not change this relationship.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml now defines SubscriptionTopic.trigger.notificationShape.resource as the focus/root for the shape and says it will be the same, a generality, or a specificity of SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource when present. source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml repeats the rule in the Notification Shape section and explains root-resource matching.

related_jiras.note: Clarified client expectations around additional resources in the same notificationShape section, but it does not require a separate FHIR-39030 source change.
